title: 适配器模式：接外部接口，为什么常要包一层？
style: Proactive business-owned notification boundary. Same example order17/recipient/message/Q17. Product operation first, then two benefits: own business contract and isolating external format upgrades. Four structural roles; target is a contract, not runtime relay. Replay one V1 request/return in shots04-06. Shots07-08 are later developer upgrade comparison only: V1 target/body and QUEUED/ticket to V2 destination/content and nested receipt ENQUEUED/reference. Preserve business Notifier/ShipmentReminder and acceptance meaning; change V2Adapter mappings and creation/wiring. No second product submission. Language-independent body; short silent Java key excerpt. No detached error story or large accepted-versus-delivered lecture, no decorative progress.
sampleDataLabel: 教学示例 · 订单17 · 不发送真实消息
discussionQuestion: 为什么先按业务需要定义通知约定？外部请求和回执格式升级时，本例哪些地方变、哪些保持？
scope: One original reminder and one complete runtime roundtrip; then a static later-upgrade comparison, not another send. Proactive adapter boundary with explicit conversion/delegation. A wrapper is not automatically an Adapter; an Adapter can support an anti-corruption boundary but is not a complete ACL. Business contract/semantics stable is the isolation precondition. Full error/delivery semantics remain in article and runnable tests.
userScope: Simplify after actual user feedback on D03/v0.63.0. Lead with two everyday reasons to proactively wrap external services: conform to a business-owned contract, and isolate external interface upgrades. Retain original order17 notification case. Show structure, one complete request/return, then one concrete V1-to-V2 format upgrade with unchanged business target/client and updated adapter/wiring. One brief anti-corruption effect/cost statement, Java key excerpt after body, no syntax lesson. Do not imply every wrapper is an Adapter or Adapter equals full ACL.
